monument_name: Gaṇeśa Phalcā at Cvachẽ (built in 1782, rebuilt 2018 CE)
description_en: The typology of Gaṇeśa Phalcāfalls under thesataḥcategory. It features an arcaded (open) ground floor with five bays and a first floor with five vertical windows facing the street. Gaṇeśa Phalcāis freestanding, with the exception of its north-eastern corner; this adjoins the neighbouring buildings. Just in front of Śaṅkha Bāhāḥ, there is acaitya, and two morephalcās(LAL4142 ans LAL4141) were also built by Avāle families from Cvachẽ. A stone staircase located outside and behind thesataḥleads to the upper floor. The Sataḥ has been rebuilt several times. After its collapse in the 2015 earthquakes, it was completely rebuilt in 2018. With the exception of some of the plinth materials (stones), all of the materials used for the reconstruction are new. The remaining historic features are the two shrines and the stone inscription.The first of these two shrines is a Gaṇeśa shrine, which is located at the center of the back wall. The Gaṇeśa statue is made of stone, and is relatively new. It measures 42 cm in height. According to a local Avāle resident, an older Gaṇeśa statue is hidden behind the current one. The second shrine is a Mahākāla shrine, which can be found on the eastern side (stone, 42 cm in height), and  features a terracottatoraṇa. The stone inscription measures 34 cm in height (without base).According to an Awale resident from the locality, the Awales of Cvache͂ were originally from Kathmandu somewhere near Ason and their lineage deity was in Lazimpat inside the Indian Embassy.  When they migrated to this area the lineage deity was also brought together with them and established in Śaṃkhamūl, Patan.
description_ne: यो गणेश फल्चा च्वछेँ टोलमा भेलाछेँबाट च्यासल जाने बाटामा रहेको छ । यस फल्चाको अगाडि शङ्ख बाहा:, एउटा चैत्य र अवाले परिवारले नै बनाएको अरू दुई फल्चा पनि रहेका छन् । फल्चाको पछाडिको गाह्रोसँग जोडिएर एउटा गणेश देवल रहेको छ । त्यहाँ रहेको गणेशको शिला मूर्ति नयाँ देखिन्छ र यसको उचाइ ४२ सेमी छ । स्थानीय वासिन्दा सानु अवालेका अनुसार गणेशको पुरानो मूर्ति त्यो नयाँ मूर्तिको पछाडि छोपेर राखिएको छ । यसको नजिकै पूर्वपट्टि महाकालको एउटा मूर्ति रहेको छ । महाकालको मूर्तिको उचाइ ४२ सेमी छ र तोरणमा गरुडको प्रतिमा छ ।
brick_type: mā apā (regular fired brick), dāci apā (conical veneer brick)
monument_assessment: Heavily damaged (collapsed, demolished, major cracks and structural damages), Rebuilt

historical_events.event_description: he Prajāpatis, who are also called Avāle (in Patan) of Bherālivi*, led bythakuBhāgideva and including Silhaṃ Bhāvo, Bhāna Singh Bhāvo, Saṃkha Bhāvo, Rakṣmiṣaṃkha Bhāvo and Mimha Bhāvo from the samecapāḥorganization of the same clan, renovated thedharmmaśālāin 1782 CE. Atympanumwas offered.Transliteration of the stone inscription of Phalcā (provided by Nutan Sharma):adya śveta varāhakalpyādi | śreyostu || sabbatasara902 ākhāḍha māsa kṛṣṇa pakṣe  (dvādasyāṃ) pra trayodasyaṃ ti-thva || jāta (Jeṣṭhā) nakṣatre || vajra yyoge yathākrrana mūhurtuke || aṃgāra-vāsare kakrata rāśite savitari mithuna rāśicandramasi || thva kunhu bhera [che͂]livi (Bhelāche͂) thāparaṃ yantāgṛha gṛha prajāpa-ti bhāgideva thakurasanaṃ silhaṃ bhāvo bhāna siṃ bhāvo saṃ-kha bhāvo rakṣmiṣaṃkha bhāvo mimha bhāvo thvti capālapiṃthuti || thao kulasala || saeva bhelogupṭhaṃ_ _ _majyādāsyaṃ cvṃgvalāka vāṣṭavya dharmmasārā jirṇo-dhāra yāsya pratiṣṭhā yāṅā juro ||  || subha ||toraṃ sahintaṃ tayā jula || dhu  || subha ||Provisional translation:On the joint day of 12 and 13th of the dark half of lunar month of Āṣāḍha, in 1782 CE (NS 902), in the installation called Jeṣṭhā, conjunction called Vajra, Yathākaraṇamūhurta (moment?), on Tuesday when the son is in Cancer and moon is in Gemini, the Prajāpatis of Bhera [che͂]livi (Bhelāche͂) led bythe thaku (senior person)Bhāgideva including Silhaṃ bhāvo,  Bhāna Singh Bhāvo, Saṃkha Bhāvo, Rakṣmiṣaṃkha Bhāvo [and] Mimha Bhāvo from the samecapāhof the own clan have renovated thedharmmaśālāsituated in Bhelogupṭhaṃ _ _ _ and established it offering a tympanum with respect. May all be well.
After the 2015 earthquakes, Lalitpur Municipality spent 41 Lac rupees to renovate the Phalcā. The locals raised money for painting and decoration. The reconstruction was completed in 2018.
